Ruin by Name.name: Ruin by Name
Ruin by Name.description: The user lays a hand on a building or a vehicle and sends the decay all through it, unmaking only the things they name: every gun, every lock, the bars of every cell, a bomb down to its last wire. Walls, floors and every person inside are left untouched, so a whole hostage scene can be disarmed and thrown open in a single moment. Strain: severe.
